priorityMeaning: Highest product-roadmap delivery priority, not incident severity.

workstreams.title: Authority, inventory and truthful baseline
workstreams.deliverable: Reproducible runtime-backed inventory and whole-app baseline.
workstreams.acceptance: Every authorable public runtime path has a disposition; another engineer can recreate the baseline from pinned inputs.

tasks.title: Record documentation SHA, runtime source SHA, installed artifact hash, Node/toolchain and deployment identity. Distinguish Git source, installed artifact and npm release tags.

Recursively inventory every public v6 method/facet and nested object, union variant, array item, default, alias, deprecated option, callback, output mode, error and resource limit; verify runtime behavior against declarations.
Reproduce whole-app typecheck/build/browser behavior on the base commit and workspace commit. Retain logs and minimal reproductions distinguishing existing failures from new-route failures.
Create a machine-readable capability ledger linking each runtime path to source evidence, model/control/graph/code mappings, execution backends, persistence, tests, owner and support status.
Review the preserved WIP branch file by file. Record usable code, defects and rejected approaches; port only reviewed pieces with their own evidence, rather than blindly cherry-picking the branch.

workstreams.title: Architecture, ownership and runtime boundaries
workstreams.deliverable: Approved ADRs and independently testable workspace adapters.
workstreams.acceptance: Browser code has no Node-native/Studio dependency; editor-specific behavior and engine behavior have clear owners.

tasks.title: Define shell/domain/compiler/browser-runtime/Node-runtime/execution/job/assets/persistence interfaces. Split the large WorkspaceApp component along real responsibilities without fragmenting trivial utilities.
Choose adapters from actual supported runtime contracts. Document browser capability negotiation and explicit fallbacks; do not assume a preview package implements the future retained renderer.
Approve ADRs for canonical schema, reversible source grammar, graph semantics, custom-code isolation, media hosting/durability, asset storage and resource/cost budgets.
Enforce dependency direction and import boundaries. New workspace modules must not import legacy Studio components, state, styles, execution adapters or generated completeness ledgers.
Separate application work from upstream portable-core/IR/browser/animation/package work. Record exact upstream capability/version blockers and removal criteria for temporary adapters.

workstreams.title: Canonical project schema, validation and transactions
workstreams.deliverable: Versioned portable project format with migrations and atomic commands.
workstreams.acceptance: Valid projects round-trip without semantic loss; rejected imports leave the last valid revision intact.

tasks.title: Define stable IDs and serializable types for documents, scenes, layers, groups/surfaces, layout, assets, graph, animation/media tracks, bindings, source mappings and export settings.
Implement whitelist validation for schema versions, finite values, unions, mutually exclusive options, references, graph cycles and aggregate resource budgets. Project data must never evaluate code.
Add validated atomic commands/transactions, revisions, deterministic serialization and semantic identities. Separate authoring state, view state and derived execution artifacts.
Migrate foundation schema version 1 without dropping values. Preserve newer/opaque values safely or reject with an exportable recovery path; test corrupt, truncated and incompatible inputs.
Define portable project/asset manifests, supported forward/backward compatibility, dangling-reference repair and transaction behavior for code/graph/visual edits.

workstreams.title: Docking, window lifecycle and layout
workstreams.deliverable: Reliable desktop, tablet and narrow-screen panel behavior.
workstreams.acceptance: Closing/restoring any panel preserves its content and jobs; all panel combinations remain recoverable.

tasks.title: Complete close/reopen/maximize/restore for all nine panels and both sidebars. Hidden split branches release space and remaining windows expand without inaccessible gaps.
Move editor selection/scroll, graph viewport/selection, terminal draft/history, inspector state, media controls and preview playback outside panel mounts. Test state across repeated closure/remount.
Implement pointer/touch/keyboard resizing with minimum sizes, accessible separators, clamped persisted weights, focus restoration and predictable maximize/restore behavior.
Add approved layout presets and configurable panel docking/movement if retained in the product contract. Recover meaningful layouts after viewport/orientation/window-size changes.
Test every panel hidden, focused-panel closure, rendering during closure/resize, corrupted layout storage, multi-tab layouts and reset. Permanent Panels and restore actions always remain available.

workstreams.title: Visual fidelity, responsive UX and accessibility
workstreams.deliverable: Consistent, inclusive production UI that preserves the approved reference.
workstreams.acceptance: No inaccessible core workflow, clipped critical action or unrecoverable window; applicable WCAG 2.2 AA criteria pass.

tasks.title: Extract scoped dark/neon tokens for surfaces, cyan/violet/yellow accents, typography, spacing, borders and motion. Preserve the accepted layout and remove root-style/custom-cursor conflicts.
Finish empty/loading/error/disabled/selected/busy/success states, validation messages, tooltips, overflow, long labels, dense toolbars and discoverable advanced controls.
Define and test desktop/tablet/mobile behavior at 1920x1080, 1440x900, 1024x768, 768x1024, 390x844 and 360x800, including zoom, orientation and actual touch/device use.
Audit landmarks, names/roles, focus order, dialogs/menus, shortcuts, resize controls and keyboard/screen-reader alternatives for canvas and graph content.
Meet applicable WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, visible focus, target-size, zoom/reflow and reduced-motion requirements. Retain reference comparisons plus manual and automated accessibility findings.

workstreams.title: Canvas, transforms and layout tools
workstreams.deliverable: Complete canvas authoring and predictable spatial editing.
workstreams.acceptance: Editing coordinates/transforms match exported results; pan/zoom never mutates document geometry or resolution.

tasks.title: Cover CanvasConfig recursively: dimensions, positions, transparency, colors/gradients, patterns, background sources/layers, fit/alignment, renderer options, defaults and limits.
Implement selection/multi-select/marquee, resize/rotate handles, transform origins, snapping/guides/grids/rulers, coordinate readout, zoom-to-fit and pan with keyboard equivalents.
Add align/distribute, stack order, locking, visibility, duplicate, grouping and supported surface/layout editing with logical-coordinate and DPR correctness.
Handle negative/off-canvas positions, rotated bounds, aspect constraints, extreme sizes and numeric-field limits. Group continuous drag/resize into one history command.
Prove each option/transform combination across controls, model, code, graph, runtime and persistence; make validation and unsupported backend behavior explicit.

workstreams.title: Text, fonts and measurement
workstreams.deliverable: Faithful text authoring and reproducible font/measurement behavior.
workstreams.acceptance: Supported typography survives round trips; missing fonts/shaping produce actionable diagnostics.

tasks.title: Cover createText and measureText recursively: font/loading/family/size/weight/style, fill/stroke, placement/baseline/alignment, spacing, wrapping, bounds and measurement results.
Add direct text editing, supported rich/multi-run content, max-width/overflow and auto-fit controls, shadows/effects and structured style editors without silent content loss.
Test multiline, punctuation, combining marks, emoji, CJK, Arabic/RTL and mixed-direction text using actual runtime shaping capabilities and declared limitations.
Make font resolution reproducible in browser/export: uploaded/embedded/referenced fonts, licensing metadata, fallback warnings, loading, cancellation and resource cleanup.
Compare metrics and generated-source results over sizes, rotation, opacity, wrapping and missing fonts; document real backend metric differences rather than assuming identical glyph pixels.

workstreams.title: Images, shapes and effect stacks
workstreams.deliverable: Deep image/shape controls and nondestructive effects.
workstreams.acceptance: Controls alter actual output; alpha, effect ordering and source data survive serialization and failure handling.

tasks.title: Cover all createImage source/shape variants, placement, crop/fit/alignment, borders/radii, stroke/fill, opacity, transforms, compositing and nested option interactions.
Expose every pinned public image utility: resize/crop/convert/compress, filters/effects, masks/blend, palette, collage/stitch and other discovered methods with valid structured controls.
Implement ordered editable/reorderable/bypassable effect stacks, alpha/color policies, incompatible-combination validation and meaningful export-conversion warnings.

Decode uploaded assets under byte/pixel/frame limits, retain originals and support replace/relink. Remote and SVG sources require explicit policy; never allow implicit arbitrary filesystem/network access.
Validate defaults/unions/arrays/interactions and generated-source parity, including transparent inputs, EXIF orientation, high-resolution sources, masks and malformed files.

workstreams.title: Paths, vectors, pixels and hit detection
workstreams.deliverable: Precise path tools, bounded pixel operations and honest selection semantics.
workstreams.acceptance: Edited geometry/detectors match runtime behavior and remain editable after save/code/graph round trips.

tasks.title: Cover every PathCommand variant, custom connectors, fill/stroke, dashes/caps/joins, gradients, shadows and transforms; represent the full supported command union.
Build point/control-handle editing, add/remove/reorder/open/close, bezier/primitive tools, coordinate fields and keyboard equivalents with atomic history.
Expose pixel read/write/manipulate operations through bounded region editors, actual data previews, explicit costs and nondestructive recovery where applicable.
Connect runtime hit tests to transforms, clipping and visibility. Distinguish exact path/region detection from a bounding-box selection approximation.
Add only runtime-supported SVG/vector import/export subsets, sanitize active content/external refs, and register future vector-engine requirements separately.

workstreams.title: Charts, data and interactions
workstreams.deliverable: All pinned chart families and their complete authoring/data contracts.
workstreams.acceptance: Every current chart family has audited editing, real output and accurate browser/static-export differences.

tasks.title: Inventory bar, horizontal bar, line, pie, scatter, radar, polar area, comparison and combo APIs with every series/data union, dimensions, axes, labels, legends and styling option.
Create bounded data/series editors with insert/edit/delete/reorder, labels/colors, scales/ranges/ticks/formatting, validation and local CSV/JSON import.
Implement supported transitions, tooltips, legends, selection and data updates. Identify browser-only interaction separately from static export behavior.
Compile charts and bindings to valid public APIs with source maps; handle zero/negative/null/empty and large bounded data according to actual runtime contracts.
Prove results/updates/accessibility summaries, source equivalence and persistence across all chart families and meaningful option interactions.

workstreams.title: Scenes, components, templates and layout
workstreams.deliverable: Reusable nested composition and a verified preset/example catalogue.
workstreams.acceptance: Instances preserve bindings/identity and every shipped example executes against the pinned runtime.

tasks.title: Expose SceneBuilder/renderScene with scene hierarchy, all layer variants, surfaces/backgrounds/order/bounds/options, immutable snapshots and public builder operations.
Add complete badge/progressBar/avatar/card/watermark editors with defaults, nested options, geometry constraints and preserved component identity.
Implement immutable template definitions/instances, placeholders, typed bindings, visibility, overrides, insertions and named refs; diagnose missing/cyclic/mistyped inputs.
Provide runtime-supported flex/grid/layout authoring and constraints. Negotiate future Apex Style/compiler capabilities rather than assuming arbitrary CSS compatibility.
Ship practical editable presets/examples across all supported domains with real public-v6 code/output, asset/font attribution, customization tests and runtime drift checks.

workstreams.title: Assets, fonts, references and files
workstreams.deliverable: Workspace-owned file/asset registry and portable inputs.
workstreams.acceptance: Projects run outside the website with all declared inputs; broken/deleted assets cannot silently corrupt dependents.

tasks.title: Build upload/import/replace/relink/delete around stable IDs, content hashes, metadata, usage/dependency references, thumbnails and safe garbage collection.
Handle image/font/GIF/audio/video/source inputs with MIME/signature validation, byte/dimension/duration quotas, progress, cancellation and actionable decode errors.
Resolve named assets/values/palettes, escaped dollar refs and templates consistently with runtime defaults; provide dependency inspection and broken-reference repair.
Export a portable bundle containing project, artwork/fonts, source, runtime/dependency metadata and usage instructions. Remove undeclared website-relative artwork dependencies.
Define transactional IndexedDB/blob storage, quotas, cache lifetime, cross-tab ownership, import atomicity and account-free offline/local workflows where supported.

workstreams.title: Code editing, reverse synchronization and execution
workstreams.deliverable: Usable code-first programming and explicit reversible/opaque source boundaries.
workstreams.acceptance: Generated programs agree with visual execution; custom programs run only in approved isolation and unsupported edits are preserved.

tasks.title: Specify and implement an AST-based reversible source subset with source spans/comments/stable IDs, diagnostics and exact unsupported-range reporting.
Connect Visual/Graph-to-Code and supported Code-to-Visual/Graph through validated transactions; preserve opaque programs and drafts, and explicitly resolve destructive overwrites.
Provide JS/TS editing, pinned API types/completion, formatting/diagnostics, files/imports, source-linked errors and runnable project/source downloads with assets.
Implement the approved isolated custom-code environment with virtual files, bounded logs/artifacts, import/network/filesystem policies, hard deadlines/cancellation and CPU/memory/process limits.

Test loops, async programs, supported imports, syntax/type/runtime failures, hangs/escapes, reload/panel closure and unsupported reverse-sync. Keep freeform programs distinct from declarative rendering.

workstreams.title: Editable typed graph and compilation
workstreams.deliverable: Meaningful node programming that drives actual execution.
workstreams.acceptance: Reconnect/create operations change the compiled render; paint order/branches are specified and tested.

tasks.title: Define semantic node/port types for inputs, canvas, text/image/path/chart/component/surface, transforms/effects, media, outputs and runtime-only capabilities.
Implement create/delete/duplicate/connect/disconnect, movement/grouping/selection, pan/zoom/fit, keyboard operation, port validation and saved graph positions.
Validate cycles, dangling refs, incompatible ports, missing inputs and aggregate costs; compile deterministic dependencies, explicit paint order, branches/composites and source maps.
Connect graph edits to shared project/code and real runtime execution. Preserve unsupported custom source as opaque nodes/boundaries rather than inventing editable semantics.
Test branches/composites, shared subgraphs, ordering, disconnected nodes, re-execution/cancellation and persistence; add accessible outline and inspectable runtime diagnostics.

workstreams.title: Unified animation and timeline
workstreams.deliverable: Shared live/export animation evaluator and timeline editing.
workstreams.acceptance: Seeking a time reproduces export semantics; final states survive interruption and reduced-motion policies.

tasks.title: Align duration/delay, from/to, property keyframes, easing, repeats/direction, transition modes, callbacks and interruption with the first-party animation contract.
Build tracks/clips/keyframes, play/pause/stop/seek, timeline zoom/snapping/ranges, playhead time, layer visibility and animation inspectors.
Use one evaluator for browser playback and deterministic server sampling; support applicable number/color/angle/transform/gradient/path interpolation with explicit discrete fallbacks.
Handle supported enter/leave/show/hide/update/active/resize/layout transitions, reduced motion, hidden tabs and frame coalescing without dropping final updates.
Prove fixed-time samples, easing endpoints, loops/reversal/interruption, rapid edits/resource disposal and preview-vs-GIF/video sampled results.

workstreams.title: GIF authoring and encoding
workstreams.deliverable: Actual editable GIF workflows under resource policy.
workstreams.acceptance: Decoded GIF frames/metadata reflect timeline edits with bounded encoding memory and real lifecycle events.

tasks.title: Cover createGIF/animate/scene-to-GIF input modes and options: dimensions, delays/durations, loops, disposal, transparency, quantization, overlays and generated/streaming frames.
Support composition sampling and imported frame sequences with insert/edit/remove/reorder, previews and explicit GIF timing-rounding diagnostics.
Integrate encoding with bounded jobs, progress/cancel/deadline/retention and supported streaming; avoid unbounded in-memory frame arrays.
Validate decoded frame count/dimensions/timing/loop/disposal/transparency and selected-frame semantics; test corrupt inputs, cancellation and memory cleanup.
Download playable GIFs and portable sources, persist settings/history and show actual encoded metadata/size and runtime limits.

workstreams.title: Audio synthesis, sequencing and mixing
workstreams.deliverable: Real procedural audio authoring, playback and waveform tools.
workstreams.acceptance: Output samples/headers/timing match controls and the waveform comes from rendered audio rather than a decorative graphic.

tasks.title: Cover synth/preset/sequence/mix/compose and every public processing API, including layers/events/partials, waveform/frequency, ADSR, modulation/filter, pan, sample/channels and deterministic seeds.
Create waveform/clip/sequence editors with playback/scrub/zoom, event timing, gain/fades, mute/solo and preset customization; derive waveforms from decoded output.
Enforce duration/sample/event/byte budgets and browser autoplay rules; release AudioContexts, buffers, URLs and workers on cancellation/replacement.
Integrate audio tracks into media exports with declared mixing/resampling/timing behavior, sync metadata, deterministic seeds and saved project settings.
Check WAV headers, channels/sample count/rate/duration, clipping/gain, seeded determinism, sequence timing and cancellation with appropriate numerical tolerances.

workstreams.title: Video editing, encoding and pipeline
workstreams.deliverable: Deployed, bounded FFmpeg-backed video workflows.
workstreams.acceptance: Actual hosted jobs produce valid probed/decoded video and terminate/clean resources reliably on failure.

tasks.title: Inventory all createVideo/videoPipeline/probe/extract/scene-to-video operations: frame creation, convert/trim, geometry/effects, text/watermarks, audio, merge/splice, speed/fades and advanced variants.
Build clip/track/timeline/operation editors with actual probe data/thumbnails, trim ranges, overlays/sync and output container/codec/quality/fps/resolution validation.
Package and integrity-check compatible FFmpeg/ffprobe binaries and licensing metadata; choose serverless vs workers using measured timeout/memory/disk/payload constraints.
Connect progress/cancellation/deadlines to actual process events, terminate process trees, isolate temporary files/protocols/paths and reclaim abandoned runs.
Use ffprobe/decoded samples to check codec/container/fps/resolution/duration/timestamps/overlays/audio/sync; test unavailable codecs, corrupt media, full disk and abrupt termination.

workstreams.title: Jobs, terminal, preview and exports
workstreams.deliverable: Coherent real execution/artifact lifecycle across every view.
workstreams.acceptance: Queued snapshots are immutable; historical artifacts stay tied to their revision; cancellation/retry cannot report false completion.

tasks.title: Define queued/admitted/running/cancelling/cancelled/completed/failed/expired states, immutable input snapshots, source revisions, job IDs and timestamped provenance.

Implement bounded admission/concurrency/fairness/backpressure, idempotent submit/retry and cancellation races; add durable workers/storage only when workload needs them and distinguish local from distributed quotas.
Separate live composition, selected historical job and custom-code output. Preview image/GIF/audio/video/text with actual metadata, playback/error states and stale-revision indicators.
Export every applicable output mode and portable project/source bundle with actual MIME/signatures, names/codec/quality/color/alpha semantics and completed browser-download checks.
Expand the documented command registry with help/history/completion, actual logs/errors/job IDs and cancellation; preserve console state across closure without implying a host OS shell.

workstreams.title: Persistence, history and recovery
workstreams.deliverable: Account-free durable local editing and explicit failure recovery.
workstreams.acceptance: Close/reload/crash/quota cases preserve the last committed work and visibly report save failures.

tasks.title: Use transactional IndexedDB/blob project/asset storage and separate small layout preferences; implement autosave revisions and visible saved/unsaved/error state.
Implement bounded command-based undo/redo across visual/code/graph/assets/media, gesture coalescing, transactional redo and measured history memory.
Recover interrupted saves/crashes/reloads/offline edits/source drafts; detect cross-tab revision conflicts and never silently overwrite newer work.
Test schema upgrade/downgrade, corrupt/truncated data, quota/storage exhaustion, deleted assets and interrupted import/export using safe backups.
Define artifact retention, safe resource reclamation, portable backups, explicit reset/delete, recovery export and user-facing storage/privacy controls.

workstreams.title: Security, isolation, privacy and abuse controls
workstreams.deliverable: Reviewed trust model and enforceable account-free execution/resource policy.
workstreams.acceptance: Malicious concurrent work cannot escape isolation, expose private inputs/secrets or evade cross-instance admission.

tasks.title: Threat-model public unauthenticated rendering, uploads/fonts/SVG/media, projects/source, plugins/dependencies, job submission and artifact access; identify every trust boundary.
Enforce signatures and bytes/pixels/frames/items/graph-depth/operations/audio-video-duration/memory/CPU/disk/process/log/concurrency limits before expensive execution.

Choose and test isolation outside the application server for custom code: deny host secrets/environment and arbitrary filesystem/network/process access; constrain imports and virtual inputs/outputs with hard termination.
Add account-free cross-instance admission/rate/cost limits, origin/CORS/CSRF policy, anonymous job ownership, unpredictable artifact access and expiry; login remains out of scope.

Test traversal, SSRF/redirects, decompression bombs, active SVG, pollution, sandbox escapes/runaway loops, cancellation races and stale/private artifact access; define patch/dependency-review procedures.

workstreams.title: Retained rendering, performance and resource lifecycle
workstreams.deliverable: Measured local interactivity with bounded resources.
workstreams.acceptance: Supported edits render directly in-browser with measured latency/frame budgets and no unbounded resource growth.

tasks.title: Integrate the retained browser renderer when its contract is ready: persistent decoded resources, dirty-node invalidation, coalescing, DPR/resize and direct presentation. Track server-PNG preview as temporary fallback.
Negotiate Worker/OffscreenCanvas/browser capabilities with tested fallback and cleanup ownership for ImageBitmap/VideoFrame/audio/URLs/resources on cancel/remount/dispose.
Benchmark named static/interactive/media workloads and ratify device/host-specific latency/frame-time/memory/cache/bundle/export budgets before performance acceptance.
Add content-addressed caches, bounded image/font/decode caches, incremental compilation and streaming/backpressure; measure cache behavior and prohibit unbounded frame retention.
Run repeated edit/resize/play/render/cancel/close soak tests plus hidden-tab/offline/low-memory scenarios; profile long tasks/leaks and preserve final updates.

workstreams.title: Testing, parity and acceptance evidence
workstreams.deliverable: Workspace-owned CI proving complete user-to-runtime flows.
workstreams.acceptance: Mandatory capability rows have executable evidence; mocks, inventory counts or green comments do not substitute for real output.

tasks.title: Implement schema/transaction/property/contract suites for compilers, graph order/types, keyframes, migrations, history, quotas and state machines.
Differentially execute visual/graph compilation and generated public-v6 programs; compare browser/Node semantics using explicit font/codec/image/numeric tolerances.
Automate Chromium/Firefox/WebKit core flows, completed downloads, visual regressions/accessibility; supplement with manual keyboard/screen-reader and real touch/device checks.
Test real API origin/validation/size/rate/admission, sandbox execution, malformed imports, timeout/cancel/retry races, persistence faults and cleanup under concurrent load.
Add inventory-drift/import-boundary/bundle-purity/full-root-build/domain-regression/performance/release-evidence gates with exact commands, fixtures, SHAs, environments and artifacts.

workstreams.title: Diagnostics, documentation and maintenance
workstreams.deliverable: Actionable errors, privacy-conscious observability and reliable help/runbooks.
workstreams.acceptance: Users can recover failures and maintainers can trace jobs without exposing private source/media/secrets.

tasks.title: Standardize stable error codes with source/node/layer/job IDs, validation/capability/execution/infrastructure classification, user context and recovery/retry guidance.
Add redacted metrics/traces for admission, queue, render, resource limits, cancel/timeout, asset decode, persistence and export failures; do not log private content by default.
Publish accurate feature help, shortcuts, synchronization boundaries, local storage/backups, export/runtime requirements and declared backend differences.
Provide contributor ownership maps, adapter contracts, architecture ADRs, pin-upgrade/drift procedures, dependency/license inventory and migration/deprecation policy.
Keep deterministic diagnostics and optional future intelligence/AI separate from rendering; require explicit capability/privacy decisions for provider integration or data egress.

workstreams.title: Full-app integration, deployment and operations
workstreams.deliverable: Reproducible hosted integration with monitoring and rollback.
workstreams.acceptance: The actual target deployment runs representative jobs under measured host limits and can recover/roll back.

tasks.title: Test the real app root layout/providers/global CSS/cursor/middleware/headers/routing, direct /workspace entry and other affected routes; do not rely on an isolated fixture.
Verify native/module/artwork/font/binary tracing, architecture/libc, compressed payload size, cold start, Node compatibility and CPU/memory/timeout/temp-disk limits.
Separate preview/staging/production config; establish secrets/CSP/runtime and binary integrity plus approved isolated-code/media infrastructure without credentials in generated programs.
Add capability/readiness probes, deploy-time real smoke jobs, monitors/alerts, retention/orphan cleanup, cost ceilings and tested rollback/recovery procedures.
Run deployed create/edit/sync/graph/render/media/download/save/reopen and cross-origin failure flows; record exact source/runtime/deployment identities, URLs and supported devices/browsers.

workstreams.title: Release acceptance, priority and future handoff
workstreams.deliverable: Reviewed production acceptance and maintainable release ownership.
workstreams.acceptance: Every mandatory gate passes on the exact promoted candidate, with no unresolved security/data-loss/release-blocking defect.

tasks.title: Reconcile every task/capability against intended production scope. Fix current v6 gaps or explicitly revise claims; mandatory partial/experimental rows cannot be counted FULL.
Run all release gates on the exact candidate: full-app, parity, UI/browser/download, accessibility, security/isolation, performance/load/soak, deployed jobs and rollback.
Publish an immutable release report with source/runtime/native identities, environments, evidence/artifacts, approved differences, residual risks and operational owners.
Promote only the accepted candidate, run post-release smoke, observe error/cost/performance budgets and rehearse rollback using a preserved previous release.
Transfer maintenance ownership and track future-engine follow-ups with exact capability/version prerequisites. Keep the P0 program open until production acceptance is recorded.
